title: PR-0.5: Capacity Watcher, simulated and unit-tested only
summary: Implement the Capacity Watcher exactly as bounded by ADR-0020: predictive usage-threshold monitoring, automatic switch trigger, both-capped terminal state, and beacon CLI UX text for in-progress/switched/paused states.
Validated only through simulated capacity-warning and hard-cap scenarios and unit tests for threshold logic, per Section 31's PR-0.5 exit evidence and Section 29A.4's honest-scoping rule.
No live provider-capacity polling: CapacityReadingSchema's source field is the literal "simulated" (no "live" variant exists in the type), and neither new module performs network I/O.
risk: Low: new, additive orchestration module and its unit tests only; no existing schema, event vocabulary entry, routing behavior, or public page changes.

The four provider-continuity event payload schemas added here (ProviderCapacityWarning, ProviderSwitchTriggered, ProviderSwitchCompleted, BothProvidersUnavailable) fill an already-reserved slot in events.ts's closed vocabulary; they do not add new event types.
testEvidence: npm run test passes 229/229, including 27 new unit tests across decision-os-capacity-watcher.test.ts and decision-os-capacity-watcher-cli.test.ts covering below-warning, warning, automatic-switch, both-capped terminal pause (both observation orderings), threshold-logic edge cases, event-payload schema validation, and exact Section 22 CLI text.
npm run format:check and npm run lint pass with no findings.
npm run ci:prepublish result for this candidate is bound to the candidate SHA and appended to the published PR body.
documentationImpact: None: this PR implements only the design/simulation/unit-test scope ADR-0020 already authorized and documented; no plan, decision, or architecture page changes.
rollback: Revert this bounded commit through the protected pull-request workflow.
No schema migration, runtime wiring, routing behavior change, or business-data change is introduced; rollback has no production impact.
